summary: Practise hazard mapping, risk registers, Bowtie analysis, and dashboards. Explore the five-day course and strengthen workplace risk assessment.
lede: Health and safety risk mapping organizes workplace hazards, exposures, controls and residual risks into reviewable registers and visual maps. For safety officers, occupational health practitioners and operations supervisors, it turns inspection and task findings into a clear risk picture. Learners practise building hazard registers, scoring risks, mapping preventive and mitigating barriers, and tracking corrective actions.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who identify workplace hazards, assess exposure, assign controls, or report occupational safety risks. It is designed for intermediate practitioners who need to turn inspection and task-level findings into a clear, reviewable risk map.
audience: Human resources and occupational health staff
modules: Job Safety Analysis and Task Risk Maps
HAZOP and FMEA for Process Hazards
Hierarchy of Controls and Workplace Layouts
Power BI Risk Dashboards and Action Plans
prerequisites: Prior experience identifying workplace hazards or contributing to a risk assessment is expected. No coding or programming is required. Bring a laptop with Excel for the spreadsheet exercises; Power BI access is optional for the dashboard activity. The course addresses AI-assisted hazard classification at conceptual awareness level, not model development or deployment.
